name: Gridfinity interlocking baseplate
description: GridFlock baseplate with jigsaw connectors, split into pieces that fit the printer bed. The default preset is thin/hollow.

drawer_size.description: Finished baseplate outer size in mm [width, depth]. Leave 1-2 mm clearance inside the drawer.

bed_size.description: Usable printer bed size in mm [width, depth]; controls how the plate is split.

alignment.description: Grid alignment within leftover padding [x, y]. 0.5 centers the grid; 0 shifts it west/south so padding collects on the east/north edge; 1 shifts it east/north so padding collects on the west/south edge.

hollow.description: Skeletonize the underside to roughly halve filament. Incompatible with magnets and the click latch.

hollow_wall.description: Hollow wall thickness in mm; 0.8 mm is two to three 0.4 mm nozzle walls.

enable_magnets.description: Cut friction-fit magnet pockets. Not compatible with hollow; use the standard preset.

click_latch.description: Enable the experimental click latch. Not compatible with hollow.

intersection_puzzle.description: Enable jigsaw connectors at cell intersections.

numbering.description: Emboss segment numbers on the underside to simplify assembly.

remove_bottom_lip.description: Replace the bottom lip with a straight wall; hollow mode always enables this.
